company.shortDescription: GoodData.AI is an AI-native decision intelligence platform built to help enterprises turn trusted data into confident action.
company.description:
GoodData.AI is the AI-native, full-stack decision intelligence platform that helps businesses turn data into actionable, enterprise-grade insights. Build, operationalize, embed, and monetize trusted analytics, workflows, and AI agents at scale—fully governed, auditable, and ready to scale.

We serve all industries worldwide, from fintech and retail to healthcare, SaaS, and manufacturing. More than 123,000 organizations and 3.9 million users rely on GoodData.
